name: prometheus.exporter.mysql

arguments.name: data_source_name
arguments.description: Data Source Name for the MySQL server to connect to.

arguments.name: disable_collectors
arguments.description: A list of collectors to disable from the default set.

arguments.name: enable_collectors
arguments.description: A list of collectors to enable on top of the default set.

arguments.name: lock_wait_timeout
arguments.description: Timeout, in seconds, to acquire a metadata lock.

arguments.name: log_slow_filter
arguments.description: Used to avoid queries from scrapes being logged in the slow query log.

arguments.name: set_collectors
arguments.description: A list of collectors to run. Fully overrides the default set.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.

data_source_name.description: Data Source Name for the MySQL server to connect to.

disable_collectors.description: A list of collectors to disable from the default set.

enable_collectors.description: A list of collectors to enable on top of the default set.

lock_wait_timeout.description: Timeout, in seconds, to acquire a metadata lock.

log_slow_filter.description: Used to avoid queries from scrapes being logged in the slow query log.

set_collectors.description: A list of collectors to run. Fully overrides the default set.

arguments.name: database
arguments.description: Database to collect heartbeat data from.

arguments.name: table
arguments.description: Table to collect heartbeat data from.

arguments.name: utc
arguments.description: Use UTC for timestamps of the current server. pt-heartbeat is called with --utc.

arguments.name: min_time
arguments.description: Minimum time a thread must be in each state to be counted.

arguments.name: processes_by_host
arguments.description: Enable collecting the number of processes by host.

arguments.name: processes_by_user
arguments.description: Enable collecting the number of processes by user.

arguments.name: info_schema_tables_databases
arguments.description: Regular expression to match databases to collect table stats for.

arguments.name: privileges
arguments.description: Enable collecting user privileges from mysql.user.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Limit the number of events statements digests, in descending order by last_seen.

arguments.name: text_limit
arguments.description: Maximum length of the normalized statement text.

arguments.name: time_limit
arguments.description: Limit how old, in seconds, the last_seen events statements can be.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.description: Regular expression to select rows in performance_schema.file_summary_by_instance.

arguments.name: remove_prefix
arguments.description: Prefix to trim away from file_name.

arguments.name: remove_prefix
arguments.description: Prefix to trim away from performance_schema.memory_summary_global_by_event_name.

targets.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
